items.t: Riverdale HS girls basketball coach on leave pending Lee County school district investigation
items.x: Riverdale High School girls' basketball coach Ryan Magiera is on administrative leave as the School District of Lee County conducts an investigation.

items.t: Florida ethics commission dismisses complaint against Lee County Sheriff Carmine Marceno
items.x: The Florida Commission on Ethics announced on Wednesday that no probable cause was found to believe that Lee County Sheriff Carmine Marceno accepted a gift or misused his position.

items.t: Judge orders 30-year prison sentence for key figure in Minnesota food fraud
items.x: A man who played a major role in defrauding a federal food program in Minnesota was sentenced Wednesday to 30 years in prison.

items.t: 83-year-old prepares for 51st NYC Marathon
items.x: David Obelkevich is the only person to complete every NYC Marathon since 1976. He's going for his 51st consecutive race this weekend.

items.t: Democrats behind effort to recruit second Dan Sullivan for Alaska Senate race, new report confirms
items.x: Democrat Mary Peltola's campaign was involved in recruiting a man with the same name as Dan Sullivan to run for Alaska's U.S. Senate seat, The New York Times reported.

items.t: James O'Keefe charged after Minnesota polling station stunt
items.x: Right-wing influencers James O’Keefe and Cameron Higby were charged with felony counts of unlawful voting and identity theft, alleged to have claimed other voters’ identities while visiting polling places.

items.t: Windy Wednesday weather; Rain chances linger into Halloween weekend
items.x: It will be another windy day with scattered showers for the Gulf Coast.

items.t: TV personality Ernie Johnson says this will be final season on 'Inside the NBA'
items.x: Ernie Johnson, the longtime television personality and sportscaster, announced Wednesday that this will be his final season hosting "Inside the NBA."

items.t: The science behind Jalen Hurts’ blood clot diagnosis is more complicated than it sounds
items.x: The Philadelphia Eagles quarterback played with a “superficial” blood clot that turned into something much more serious. Where did things go wrong?

items.t: Alvin K. Hellerstein, a federal judge who handled Trump, Maduro and 9/11 cases, dies at 92
items.x: Alvin K. Hellerstein, a Manhattan federal judge who presided over matters involving President Trump, former Venezuelan President Maduro and the 9/11 attacks, has died.

items.t: Man accused of hit-and-run on Cape Coral canal marker that caused $1,000 in damage
items.x: A man was arrested after officers with the Cape Coral Police Department say he hit a canal marker and drove away.

items.t: Tom Jones postpones tour dates to recover from illness
items.x: The "It's Not Unusual" singer has been on his 25-date "Come Gather Round North American Tour" since the middle of September.

items.t: Federal Reserve keeps rates unchanged despite elevated inflation
items.x: The Federal Reserve kept its key rate unchanged Wednesday at about 3.9% despite elevated inflation, while providing little hint about the central bank’s next moves.

items.t: Iran War's cost to American taxpayers grows to an estimated $47.1 billion
items.x: The cost of the Iran War to American taxpayers has grown to $47.1 billion, according to a new estimate the Pentagon has provided to Congress.

items.t: UN condemns US economic embargo of Cuba though more nations sit out after Trump administration push
items.x: The U.N. General Assembly condemned the U.S. economic embargo of Cuba for the 34th year on Wednesday, even as Washington’s campaign to influence the outcome led to a number of countries voting against the resolution.

items.t: Man arrested after shots fired in Charlotte County road rage incident
items.x: A white SUV was left with bullet holes and a flat tire after a Charlotte County road rage incident that ended in an arrest.

items.t: New study suggests 3 in 4 former NFL players who died from 2008 to 2023 had CTE
items.x: A new study published Wednesday estimates about 3 in 4 former NFL players who died between 2008 and 2023 had CTE, far higher than earlier estimates.

items.t: Estero council reviews $20 million rail trail land purchase
items.x: The Village of Estero council discussed the purchase and sale agreement for 66.7 acres of land, valued at nearly $20 million, as part of the rail trail project ahead of Thursday's deadline.

items.t: ADHD linked to higher risk of late-life cognitive impairment and dementia in new study
items.x: A new study adds to evidence that ADHD and late-life cognitive impairment and dementia are associated, though it doesn't establish that one causes the other.

items.t: Man prepares to hand out 14,000 candy bars for Halloween
items.x: Peter Geiger's Halloween party is one of the biggest draws on Halloween in Maine each year and this year, he is stepping up his game, thanks to a little help.
